DELETE FROM EDS.RIB_TRANSACTIONDETAILS WHERE AS_OF_DATE = CAST(@DatetoProcessed AS DATE);

INSERT INTO EDS.RIB_TRANSACTIONDETAILS(

,BANK_ID
,TXN_ID
,REQ_SR_NO
,DB_TS
,CP_ENTITY_TYPE
,CP_ENTITY_ID
,CP_ENTITY_EXTN1
,CP_ENTITY_EXTN2
,CP_ENTITY_EXTN3
,CP_ENTITY_NICKNAME
,CP_REMARKS
,CP_ROUTING_NO
,CP_ACCT_CRN
,TRAN_ACT_ENTITY_TYPE
,TRAN_ACT_ENTITY_ID
,TRAN_ACT_ENTITY_EXTN1
,TRAN_ACT_ENTITY_EXTN2
,TRAN_ACT_ENTITY_NICKNAME
,TRAN_ACT_REMARKS
,TRAN_ACT_CRN
,VALUE_DATE
,CHANNEL_ID
,ENTRY_AMT
,TOTAL_ENTRY_AMT
,LIMIT_AMT_IN_HOMECRN
,LIMIT_RATE
,LIMIT_RATE_CODE
,CHARGE_AMT
,CHARGE_CRN
,NW_COMMISSION_AMT

,RESPONSE_CODE
,RESPONSE_MSG
,PYMT_SRL_NO
,NO_OF_RETRIES
,HOST_REF_NO
,BNF_DISPLAY_ID
,BORPI_DWNLD_DT
,BORPI_DWNLD_FILE_NUM
,CONSUMER_CODE
,BENEFICIARY_REFERENCE
,EXTRA_TRANSACTION_INFO
,NOTIFICATION_REF_NO
,EXTERNAL_REF_NO
,LAST6_ACCT_NUM
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
)
SELECT 
@DatetoProcessed AS AS_OF_DATE
,BANK_ID
,TXN_ID
,REQ_SR_NO
,DB_TS
,CP_ENTITY_TYPE
,CP_ENTITY_ID
,CP_ENTITY_EXTN1
,CP_ENTITY_EXTN2
,CP_ENTITY_EXTN3
,CP_ENTITY_NICKNAME
,CP_REMARKS
,CP_ROUTING_NO
,CP_ACCT_CRN
,TRAN_ACT_ENTITY_TYPE
,TRAN_ACT_ENTITY_ID
,TRAN_ACT_ENTITY_EXTN1
,TRAN_ACT_ENTITY_EXTN2
,TRAN_ACT_ENTITY_NICKNAME
,TRAN_ACT_REMARKS
,TRAN_ACT_CRN
,VALUE_DATE
,CHANNEL_ID
,ENTRY_AMT
,TOTAL_ENTRY_AMT
,LIMIT_AMT_IN_HOMECRN
,LIMIT_RATE
,LIMIT_RATE_CODE
,CHARGE_AMT

,RESPONSE_MSG
,PYMT_SRL_NO
,NO_OF_RETRIES
,HOST_REF_NO
,BNF_DISPLAY_ID
,BORPI_DWNLD_DT
,BORPI_DWNLD_FILE_NUM
,CONSUMER_CODE
,BENEFICIARY_REFERENCE
,EXTRA_TRANSACTION_INFO
,NOTIFICATION_REF_NO
,EXTERNAL_REF_NO
,LAST6_ACCT_NUM
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME) as insert_dttm
FROM D360.STG_EDS_RIB_TRANSACTIONDETAILS
WHERE H = 'D'
